question: In which festival of Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh, are the bullocks and other cattles used for agriculture worshipped?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pola Festival.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Pola is a festival of the state of__ Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh.​ 
 
• It is celebrated by the farmers by the worship of the bull. 
 
• The farmers decorate their bulls and on this day and then worship them to perform in the festival.
 
• This festival is celebrated to show their gratitude towards the bulls for their assistance in the agricultural works by the farmers.
 
• From the following day of the festival, the plowing activities are started and seeds are sown in the fields.
